problem_statement: StartBootstrap/startbootstrap-stylish-portfolio (rebranded here as the bespoke joinery studio Kestrel & Wick) is a Bootstrap 5 portfolio site built with a Pug + SCSS + vanilla-JS pipeline that compiles to a static dist/. It has a home page (masthead hero, About, Services, a shared Recent Projects work grid, and a #contact location panel) plus two secondary pages reachable from the slide-out sidebar: a Projects page and an About-the-studio page. The studio's Recent Projects grid is presented through an interactive 'Studio work finder': a row of category tabs (All, Cabinetry, Staircases, Kitchens, Seating) sits above a grid of six project cards, and a readout line reports how many projects are shown. Clicking a category tab must filter the grid live to the matching project cards and rewrite the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' (with 'Showing all 6 projects' for All). The same work finder is embedded on the home page, the Projects page, and the About page so a visitor can browse the studio's work from wherever they land. A regression has crept in on three fronts: (1) on a 390px phone the tab row is pinned to a fixed non-wrapping width and runs off the right edge, dragging the whole document into horizontal overflow; (2) the tab row and card grid look visually broken - tabs are clipped and cards shingle over one another; and (3) clicking a tab flips the active-tab highlight but the grid never re-filters and the readout stays frozen at 'Showing all 6 projects', and on the Projects and About pages the work finder is missing entirely. Restore the Studio work finder so that: it fits every viewport with no horizontal overflow; the tab row and card grid lay out cleanly (no clipping or overlap); clicking a tab filters the grid to the matching cards and updates the count readout live; and the finder is present on all three pages (home, Projects, About). Leave the masthead, Services, sidebar navigation, #contact panel, copy, and the rest of the Bootstrap theme unchanged.
required_content: The Studio work finder renders a tab row (All, Cabinetry, Staircases, Kitchens, Seating), a readout line, and a grid of six project cards (Oak Sideboard, Reading Nook, Spiral Stair, Studio Kitchen, Green Oak Bench, Loft Staircase), each card carrying its category badge.

Clicking a category tab filters the grid to only the matching project cards and rewrites the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>'; clicking Staircases shows exactly the two staircase projects and reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Staircases'. The All tab restores all six cards and reads 'Showing all 6 projects'.
The tab row and card grid lay out cleanly at every viewport: on a 390px phone the tab row wraps instead of forcing horizontal overflow, and the cards never clip or overlap one another.
The Studio work finder is present on the home page, the Projects page, and the About page (the shared 'Studio work finder' heading and its card grid appear on all three).

The slide-out sidebar navigation (Home / About / Services / Projects / Contact), the masthead hero, the four Services cards, and the #contact location panel remain present and unchanged in content and structure.

No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced; the site continues to serve as a self-contained static build with locally vendored Bootstrap, Font Awesome, Simple Line Icons, and the web font.
design_constraints: Preserve the Stylish Portfolio design language: teal primary accent, full-bleed section rhythm, the fixed slide-out sidebar menu, and the multi-page navigation.
The work finder's filtering must be driven by the clicked category and reflect the true count of matching cards; the readout must never report a stale count after a tab is clicked.
Fix the layout so the tab row wraps and the card grid reflows responsively; do not mask overflow with body/html-level overflow:hidden or by clipping cards off-screen.
The finder must fit 390px mobile, 834px tablet, and 1440px desktop; all tabs and cards must remain readable at every size.

Keep the shared work-finder component identical across the home, Projects, and About pages, and keep the Pug/SCSS/JS build pipeline intact - `npm run build` must still emit a working static dist/ with index.html, projects.html, and about.html.
state_constraints: desktop_home and desktop_workfinder capture the home page at 1440px: the sidebar, masthead, and the Studio work finder (tab row + six-card grid + readout) all fit with no horizontal overflow.

mobile_home and mobile_workfinder capture the home page at 390px: with the defect the tab row runs off the right edge and forces the document wider than the viewport; the repair wraps the tab row so horizontal overflow stays within tolerance.
desktop_filter_staircases captures the home page after clicking the Staircases tab: the grid filters to the two staircase projects and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Staircases'.
desktop_projects, mobile_projects, and desktop_about confirm the Studio work finder is embedded on the Projects and About pages as well as the home page.
tablet_home captures the home page at 834px, where the finder already fits and must continue to fit after the repair. desktop_contact confirms the #contact location panel remains intact.

change_completion: Clicking a category tab filters the grid to the matching project cards and updates the readout to the true 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' count.
The Studio work finder is present and functional on the home, Projects, and About pages.
All six project cards and their category badges keep their exact labels across viewports.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the Stylish Portfolio Bootstrap identity, section order, and all surrounding content.
The tab row and card grid lay out cleanly with no clipped tabs or shingled/overlapping cards.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the tab row wraps responsively so the document width stays within the viewport (no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance).
At 834px tablet and 1440px desktop the finder stays responsive and lays out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Sidebar navigation, masthead, Services, and the #contact panel remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded task on the static StartBootstrap Stylish Portfolio template (Pug/SCSS/JS -> dist/), rebranded to the joinery studio Kestrel & Wick and extended to three real pages (index.html, projects.html, about.html). The native lever is the portfolio's own Recent Projects work grid, presented as a 'Studio work finder' whose category tabs filter the six project cards (Oak Sideboard, Reading Nook, Spiral Stair, Studio Kitchen, Green Oak Bench, Loft Staircase) and drive a live count readout. Four orthogonal defects distinguish the legs: mobile horizontal overflow from a fixed non-wrapping tab row (D6), a visually broken tab-row and card-grid restyle with clipped tabs and shingled cards (D3 visual regression over the work-finder image crops), the work finder missing from the Projects and About pages (D2 cross-page presence), and a frozen filter whose readout never leaves 'Showing all 6 projects' after a tab click (D4 interaction). The reference wraps the tab row, lays the grid out on a fluid auto-fill grid, wires the click handler to re-filter and rewrite the readout, and embeds the finder on all three pages. Leg-varying files: src/scss/sections/_workfinder.scss, src/js/scripts.js, src/pug/projects.pug, src/pug/about.pug. The photographs are the template's own portfolio images.
